speed_bin_convention: Left closed, right open; last edge positive infinity; original sum-reduction LSQ speed
group_naming: stationary is the unchanged original future-GT static group; future motion group is not a past-motion label
group_and_bin_scope: Three radar strata times four original future-GT groups at all speeds; seven individual speed bins only for no_radar/all
population: Original future-valid AND CRN-uncovered (owner<0); all original source points retained
common_population: Within every cell, all six dimensionless metrics, three secondary AUC scores, two reference correlations, and four continuous descriptors use exactly reference_reason_code==0; no extra filter
point_weight: 1 / number of ALL original points in that object; never renormalized to uncovered, camera-valid, pose-valid, radar or speed subset
denominator: ALL original future-valid objects per horizon/group, including fully covered and all camera/pose-missing objects

metric_definitions.delta_eD_minus_eGT: corr_GT - corr_D, positive means GT-reference patch residual below D residual
metric_definitions.delta_eZero_minus_eGT: corr_GT - corr_zero, positive means GT-reference patch residual below zero residual
metric_definitions.broken_delta_eD_minus_eGT: broken_corr_GT - broken_corr_D, same past-image width//2 circular-roll control
metric_definitions.actual_minus_broken_delta_eD_minus_eGT: delta_eD_minus_eGT - broken_delta_eD_minus_eGT on the exact same points
metric_definitions.actual_minus_broken_delta_eZero_minus_eG: delta_eZero_minus_eGT - broken_delta_eZero_minus_eGT on the exact same points

dimensionless_summary.units: Dimensionless correlation differences, NOT physical EPE
dimensionless_summary.signs: Positive/zero/negative original weight fractions on identical common population; zero uses exact equality
dimensionless_summary.empty: Conditional and sign fractions null; full contribution zero when original denominator exists, otherwise null

reference_correlations: Original-object-point-weighted conditional mean of GT and broken GT correlations on same reference-valid population
descriptor_weighting: Same reference-valid population; original-object-point-weighted conditional means only; units m for displacement/error and px for image departure; no added bin or filter

secondary_auc.label: Bpast_cam = norm(GTdisp_past_xy) - norm(GTdisp_past_xy - dt_camera_past_minus_lidar_t0 * original_four_horizon_sum_LSQ_D_xy)
secondary_auc.zero: Excluded only from binary AUC and counted
secondary_auc.population: Exactly common reference-valid support for all three scores
secondary_auc.undefined: null if either weighted class is absent
secondary_auc.forbidden: No AUC with nonnegative GT-D error as all-positive label; no AUC of new GT-reference deltas; no future-benefit AUC

physical_missingness: All six reference reason partitions retain unchanged original FUTURE physical benefit/gain/cost with ALL original object denominator; no missing-score zero fill
timestamp_and_bracket_validation: Collector/core verify raw sample annotation times and interpolation links; analyzer verifies frozen source hashes, old timestamp ledger, alpha in [0,1], and historical slot indices <=2; actual-past dt uses selected original camera time minus original LiDAR t0
limitations: Privileged historical GT-reference diagnostic; not a deployable signal or mathematical upper bound
Virtual material points inside original boxes are not certified visible surfaces
Rigid box interpolation and original perspective patches may not identify real photometric correspondence
Future GT group is not a past motion classification; past-displacement/error descriptors are reported without new filtering
Original repeated image patches and object points are not IID
train512 / 256 scenes was seen by D; no unseen-scene generalization claim
Dimensionless correlation effects and signed past-benefit AUC do not establish future motion, occupancy or routing improvement
